{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats believe the Western Hemisphere is America's strategic home base—a region bound together by common values, history, and vision of a more prosperous, democratic, and secure future.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States will turn the page on the Trump Administration's denigration and extortion of its neighbors at next year's Summit of the Americas.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States will chart a new era of cooperation based on partnership and shared responsibility for the region at next year's Summit of the Americas.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will reaffirm the importance of North America to U.S. global economic competitiveness.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will ensure the USMCA lives up to its commitment to create prosperity for American workers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will strictly enforce compliance with the USMCA's labor and environmental provisions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will reinvigorate and build upon the North American Plan for Animal and Pandemic Influenza launched under the Obama-Biden Administration.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will work with partners to recover from the COVID-19 pandemic, which has caused the biggest economic decline in history across Latin America and the Caribbean.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Rather than coerce neighbors into supporting cruel migration policies, Democrats will work with regional and international partners to address the root causes of migration—violence and insecurity, weak rule of law, lack of educational and economic opportunity, pervasive corruption, and environmental degradation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Rather than encourage climate denial and environmental devastation, Democrats will rally the world to protect the Amazon from deforestation.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will protect Indigenous peoples.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will help vulnerable nations in the Caribbean and Central America adapt to the impacts of climate change.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Rather than imitate populist demagogues, Democrats will link arms with neighbors to realize shared aspirations for the region's future.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will reject President Trump's failed Venezuela policy, which has only served to entrench Nicolás Maduro's dictatorial regime and exacerbate a human rights and humanitarian crisis.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States will mobilize its partners across the region and around the world to meet the urgent needs of the people of Venezuela.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The United States will grant Temporary Protected Status to Venezuelans in the United States.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe the best opportunity to rescue Venezuela's democracy is through smart pressure and effective diplomacy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Smart pressure and effective diplomacy are Democrats' believed opportunity to rescue Venezuela's democracy, not empty, bellicose threats untethered to realistic policy goals and motivated by domestic partisan objectives.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
